lines: Is darja badgumaan hain khuloos-e-bashar se hum
couplets.en: We have come to doubt the sincerity of others so deeply.

lines: Is darja badgumaan hain khuloos-e-bashar se hum
couplets.en: We have come to doubt the sincerity of others so deeply.

lines: Apnon ko dekhte hain paraayi nazar se hum
couplets.en: We look on our own as though they were strangers.

lines: Wallaah tujh se tark-e-ta'alluq ke baad bhi
couplets.en: I swear, even after I broke with you.

lines: Aksar guzar gaye hain teri rahguzar se hum
couplets.en: I often found myself passing down your street.

lines: Ghunchon se pyaar kar ke ye izzat hamein mili
couplets.en: Such was the honour we earned for loving the buds.

lines: Ghunchon se pyaar kar ke ye izzat hamein mili
couplets.en: Such was the honour we earned for loving the buds.

lines: Choome qadam bahaar ne guzre jidhar se hum
couplets.en: Spring kissed our feet wherever we passed.
